description.text: Training objectives: This major cultivates high-quality application-oriented professionals who meet the needs of economic and social development, have excellent general knowledge, solid professional quality, outstanding innovation quality, comprehensive development of morality, intelligence, physique, beauty and labor, systematically master the basic theory, basic knowledge and basic skills of nursing major, have basic clinical nursing work ability, preliminary teaching ability, management ability, scientific research ability and innovation ability, and can engage in nursing and preventive health care in various medical and health care institutions. Characteristic advantages: medical education collaborative education, continuous optimization of teaching resources, reform of teaching methods, and promotion of students' independent learning. With nursing education experts from Tongji Hospital affiliated to Tongji Medical College of Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Wuhan University People's Hospital and other practice hospitals inside and outside the province, we have jointly built a nursing professional resource database and implemented the trinity teaching mode of "theoretical teaching-simulation training-clinical practice", and more than 90% of students are employed in domestic third-class hospitals.

duration.text: The Nursing at Wuchang University of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1666 USD/per year ￥ 12000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Colored scanned copy of passport which is valid for at least one year 2. White background colored bareheaded digital photo in Passport size(The head takes up 2/3 of the size of the photo; the photo pixel is no less than 320*240, the aspect ratio is 4:3, the size is 100-500kb, JPG format) 3. The colored scanned copy of the original diploma of secondary high school and above (If it is not in English, an English or Chinese translation shall be provided.) 4. The colored scanned copy of the original transcript of secondary high school and above (If it is not in English, an English or Chinese translation shall be provided.) 5. Educational background and working experience detailed from primary school to the date of application 6. Transfer letter with attendance record for applicants with studying experience in China 7. Fixed deposit certificate with minimum US $3000 8. Medical report 9. None criminal record

requirements.text: Non-Chinese citizens, physically and mentally healthy. Non-Chinese citizens of secondary high school graduates, holding valid foreign passports in good health and with good character.
